This declares a binding named after a global the rest of the file assumes is the global. Every read of that name inside the new scope gets this binding instead, so a comparison against `undefined` compares against whatever was assigned here, `NaN` stops being the value no comparison equals, and `arguments` stops being the call's arguments. The damage is silent and it is not local to this line: the code that breaks is the code that never mentioned the shadow and reads the name expecting the global. Rename the binding.
